correctness.rationale: For exactly the degrees in scope, the stipulated response is equivalent to (I+A)x=1 over F₂. The set of solutions is nonempty since for any y in the kernel, yᵀ(I+A)y=yᵀ1=0, so 1 lies in the range of the symmetric matrix. For an independent count use the homogeneous rung recurrence z[i+1]=z[i−1]+Nz[i], with N=I+S and N²=0. Hence z[i+2]=z[i]+Nz[i+1], z[i+3]=z[i+1]+Nz[i], and z[i+4]=z[i]. The affine recurrence has the same period-four property since its additional constant e satisfies Ne=0 and cancels on the fourth step. Open ghost rungs at 0 and n+1 are zero; the homogeneous right constraint, in residue order 0,1,2,3, is z[1]=0, Nz[1]=0, z[1]=0, or vacuous. The cylinder imposes the nth shift as the identity; residues 0 and 2 leave 16 and 4 patterns, and odd residues force a constant in ker N (2 patterns). On the Möbius ladder the shift is S: residue 0 requires Nz[0]=Nz[1]=0 (4), residue 2 requires N(z[0]+z[1])=0 (8), and an odd shift squared is a two-shift, forcing both parity states in ker N, then forcing them to agree (2). The admissible sizes make the edges simple and include both initial rungs, so these counts are of distinct labeled vectors.
